column1: # Rust: fn (free, in an impl, a trait signature), struct and enum (listed as classes), trait (interface), const and static (constant; static mut is a variable), type aliases including
# associated types in a trait and in an impl, inline `mod name { ... }` (listed as a package), and macro_rules! (listed as a function).
# Not definitions: `mod external;` (a file, not a body), a use, a call, a macro invocation (format!, vec!, print_error!), a field, a local binding.
